## Epson EcoTank L3250

A print-scan-copy inkjet printer with refillable ink tanks that cut printing costs dramatically.

- Print, scan and copy
- Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi Direct printing from phones
- Bundled ink bottles print thousands of pages
